It takes a lot of courage to reach out, and wanting to heal before starting nursing school is a wonderful, positive goal. Dealing with bulimia, anxiety, and anger for six years is incredibly exhausting, and it makes complete sense that you want to break this cycle once and for all. Please know that recovery is absolutely possible, and you deserve to feel at peace with yourself.

To get started, reaching out to a therapist or medical professional who specializes in eating disorders is a crucial step. You can contact the National Alliance for Eating Disorders helpline at 866-662-1235 to find treatment options, specialists, and support groups in your area. Additionally, if you ever feel overwhelmed by anxiety or the urge to purge and need immediate support, you can text HOME to 741741 to connect with the Crisis Text Line. You are taking a brave first step toward a healthier future, and there is professional support available to help you get there.
